text:
Ana: Heads-up — webinar next Wed 2pm PT: "Serving LLMs at scale". Need social plan: X + LinkedIn threads, hero image, 3 teaser posts, RT cadence, webinar landing link. Who can own scheduling + seed lists?
Jordan: I can own scheduling. Plan: 2 teaser tweets (1 week out, 2 days out), 1 same-day live push, LinkedIn longform + short link post. Need hero image by EOD Thu.
Mike_S: I'll build the seed lists from registrants + PLG signups. How many promos to send to SDRs? 200-300 warm leads each?
Sara_K: For copy, recommend 3 variants: benchmark lead (latency/cost win), customer story (churn down), product demo (how-to). Jordan, want to A/B the first tweet copy?
Jordan: Yes. A/B: (A) "We cut inference cost 2.5x w/ caching + quantization" vs (B) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency — here's how".
Lia_Ops: Asset note — hero must be 1200x628 (X card) + alternate 1080x1080 for LinkedIn. Upload to /drive/marketing/webinar-assets. Also add 2 alt headlines for accessibility.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Serving LLMs at scale" • Wed 14:00 PT • Zoom link added.
Ana: @lia_ops pls add UTM params. Example: `?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_serving_2026&utm_medium=social`
Mike_S: Seedlist: will filter by org size >100, used embedding features, and recent activity (30d). Export ready by Monday.
Jordan: Scheduling deck — I'll put drafts in the scheduler. Need final copy by Tue EOD. @sara_k can you post the 3 copy variants in this thread so @lia_ops can start designs?
Sara_K: Copy variants below: 1) Benchmark: "We reduced inference cost 2.5x while keeping median latency <200ms. See our approach → [link]" 2) Story: "How Acme scaled chat to 100k monthly users without skyrocketing costs → [link]" 3) Demo: "Live: how we tune batching, caching, and quantization for consistent SLOs → [link]"
Lia_Ops: Started designs — dropping placeholder in drive. Two notes: show "Live demo" CTA and include local time conversions for AM/EMEA audiences.
Ana: Engagement follow-ups: immediate replies from community manager for first hour, then nurture drip: 3-email sequence + SDR outreach within 48h for qualified registrants. @mike_s what's the SLA on handoff to SDRs?
Mike_S: SLA 24-48h for hot leads (attended + clicked demo). Will tag leads with `lead_score:high` and push to Sales queue via Zapier.
Jordan: Also want a benchmark thread on X the day after webinar highlighting the key graphs — need permission to use internal benchmark slides. @engineering, anyone object? :eyes:
Sara_K: 👍 from me — just mask any customer PII. Lia will add callouts for visuals. @ana can you confirm we can publish the cost graphs?
Ana: Confirmed — keep raw numbers high-level, use % improvements and aggregate metrics. Ok team — next steps summarized in scheduler doc: designs by Thu, final copy Tue, seed export Mon, scheduling Wed morning. :party-parrot:
